paragraphs.text: Last Saturday, Momo walked to the hills with his friend Lily. The hills were far away. Momo was the smallest dinosaur in his family. But he was brave and happy.
paragraphs.translation: 上周六，莫莫和好朋友莉莉一起走到了山丘那边。山丘离家很远。莫莫是家里最小的恐龙，可他既勇敢又快乐。

paragraphs.text: Behind some tall trees, they found a big cave. It was dark and cold inside. Lily said, "This is the oldest cave here."
paragraphs.translation: 在高高的树后面，他们发现了一个大山洞。洞里又黑又冷。莉莉说：“这是这儿最古老的山洞。”

paragraphs.text: They walked in slowly because they were a little afraid. Then they saw old pictures on the wall. The pictures were the most amazing thing in the valley. They showed big dinosaurs and blue rivers.
paragraphs.translation: 他们因为有点儿害怕，所以慢慢地走了进去。接着，他们看到了墙上的古老图画。那些图画是山谷里最神奇的东西。画上有大恐龙和蓝色的河流。

paragraphs.text: Near the wall, Momo found a small blue stone. It was the most beautiful stone in Dino Valley. Momo put it in his bag.
paragraphs.translation: 在墙边，莫莫发现了一块小小的蓝石头。那是恐龙谷里最漂亮的石头。莫莫把它放进了自己的包里。

paragraphs.text: Suddenly, a loud sound came from outside. It was the loudest roar of the day. They ran out quickly because they felt afraid.
paragraphs.translation: 突然，外面传来一声巨响。那是那一天最响亮的吼叫声。他们因为害怕，飞快地跑了出来。

paragraphs.text: Outside, Grandpa Dino was waiting for them. "That was my loudest roar!" he said with a smile. Momo laughed and showed him the blue stone. "This cave is the oldest place in the valley," said Grandpa. "Please keep it a secret."
paragraphs.translation: 洞外，恐龙爷爷正在等他们。“那是我最响亮的吼声！”他笑着说。莫莫也笑了，把蓝石头拿给他看。“这个山洞是山谷里最古老的地方，”爷爷说，“请你们保守这个秘密。”
